Added 5 new V2 tests on top of iteration_21: (a) GET /radar/settings returns companies as objects {name,enabled,portal_url,kind,slug}, no 'boards' key, and configured={jooble,adzuna,workday,boards}; (b) POST /radar/portal/detect requires auth (401 w/o token); (c) Desjardins Workday URL -> ok:true, kind:workday, count>0 (real network call succeeded); (d) Hydro-Québec URL -> ok:false, kind:'' with message mentioning 'Jooble'; (e) dashboard last_run contains selected_sources + by_source{jooble,workday,boards,adzuna} each with {fetched,analyzed}, sources_status.configured covers all 4, sources_status.selected is a list, analyzed_today<=50. Existing coverage retained: adzuna dropped from sources when no key, invalid kind -> 422, case-insensitive duplicate names removed, plain string companies accepted, portal_url parsed into kind/slug (desjardins.wd10/Desjardins), /run returns {started:true} immediately with 409 concurrent, dedupe second run (new=0, known>=1), IPS score 0-100 + priority A/B/C + decision_report.summary 'IPS officiel CareerOS : N/100 — priorité X.', ignore/pack flows with CO-YYYY-NNNNNN + origin.type='radar' + idempotency + cross-member 404, cron 401/200, email draft + PATCH status 'pret', interview + .ics (BEGIN:VCALENDAR, DTSTART, SUMMARY, CO code in DESCRIPTION), ics cross-member 404. Frontend /careeros/radar: SourceStatus panel (radar-source-status) renders all 4 sources; jooble='Non configuré' (amber), adzuna='Non configuré' (amber), workday='58 offres' (green), boards='35 offres' (green), total panel 'Total : 0 offres analysées sur 93 trouvées' visible (seed hit daily limit of 50 earlier today so analyzed=0 on new run — expected). Settings dialog (radar-settings-btn opens radar-settings-dialog): source chips present for all 4 kinds; jooble and adzuna chips disabled with text ' · Non configuré', workday & boards chips enabled/toggleable. CompanyManager (radar-company-manager): 20/20 actives on seed; row 0 (ABB) toggle via radar-company-enabled-0 changes checked state and restores; add via radar-company-add-name + radar-company-add-url + radar-company-add-btn adds a new row (TESTCo w/ workday URL) and shows radar-company-check-{i} 'Vérifier' button when kind empty; radar-import-toggle reveals radar-import-textarea, pasting 'TESTCo2 | https://boards.greenhouse.io/testco2\nTESTCo3' then radar-import-btn adds 2 rows (merge on duplicate names); radar-company-remove-{i} removes rows; radar-settings-save-btn persists (reopen shows 20 rows, zero TESTCo remaining). No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: SourceStatus.jsx hardcodes dark colors (bg-[#121520]/80, text-slate-200/400). Shell may provide a light theme wrapper; verify this panel contrasts well in light mode. Consider using tokenized theme classes (bg-card, text-muted-foreground) for consistent light/dark rendering.

RadarSettings.jsx keywords input still uses defaultValue + onBlur (iteration_21 remark still applies). If the member types and immediately clicks 'Enregistrer', Safari may drop the blur in rare cases; prefer value/onChange or key the form on `s`.

CompanyManager.parseImport treats a plain line containing '|' as separator but splits lines without '|' and without http on commas — this is reasonable but a line like 'Google LLC' would stay intact while 'Google,LLC' would split; document the format in the placeholder (currently helpful but concise).
radar.py put_settings persists companies with case-insensitive dedupe but the display order follows the order sent; UI additions via mergeCompanies keep order — good. No issue, just note.

radar.py `/portal/detect` returns ok:false for amazon.jobs if slug detection returns 'amazon' and amazon() fails network; message is user-friendly. Consider rate-limiting /portal/detect per user — currently unauthenticated external HTTP calls can be fired via an authenticated endpoint (minor abuse risk).

radar.py _fetch: `for src, fn in (('adzuna', S.adzuna), ('jooble', S.jooble)): if src in srcs:` iterates company-level Jooble searches `comps[:JOOBLE_COMPANY_LIMIT]` even if the base aggregator Jooble call wasn't configured — it is still gated by configured() inside the fn (returns [] if no key), so no network waste beyond the empty short-circuit, but tasks are still appended + awaited. Minor efficiency: skip appending when `not conf[src]`.

CompanyManager row grid `grid-cols-[auto_1fr_1.4fr_auto_auto]`: with long portal URLs (Workday) the kind badge can wrap awkwardly on < lg screens. Consider adding `min-w-0 truncate` on the URL input container.
